purpose: Smallest repo that exercises the cross-file claim. Used for the first end-to-end audit, where the point is proving the pipeline runs -- not measuring detection rate.

planted.why_cross_file: The credential is defined in lib/config.py and written to logs in app/handlers.py. Neither file alone shows the leak.
Untrusted input enters in app/handlers.py and reaches an unparameterised execute() in lib/db.py via execute_raw().

not_planted: app/util.py contains no vulnerability. A finding against it is a false positive.
lib/db.py execute_safe() is correctly parameterised. Flagging it is a false positive.
notes: Line numbers are 1-indexed and refer to the files as committed. If you edit the fixture, update them -- the grounding check compares against these.
